Name: Protosynthesis
Effect: While Sunny Weather is active, or if this Pokémon is holding an Energy Booster; increase this Pokémon's Strength, Dexterity, Special, Defense or Special Defense by 1. If their highest stat is Dexterity, Defense or Special Defense increase it by 2, instead. Unique Ability.
Description: This Pokémon's primal energy is barely contained. Sunlight powers them up and brings up a wilder and savage behaviour.
